title: Creative AI Dance Video - I’m Living In Color - Kelly Boesch | 4k
description:
👉 I post new AI art and cinematic videos every day — subscribe to follow the journey.

Friday dance party! I’ve been asked several times why I make most of my videos in horizontal format. There are a few reasons. One because you can get more action into the scene, especially with a video like this one and two, because many people watch my videos on their tvs. I can see how people consume my videos in the analytics. Most watch on TV on YT. So I tried it. I put on one of my playlists of videos and watched on my tv and they actually look so good. I’m working on a 4k playlist. My workflow for this video: images were made in #Midjourney and animated using #VEO3. Song "I'm Living in Color" made using @suno  

#ai #aiart #suno  #aivideo #aimusic

top_comments.author: @BlairLogan-x8u
top_comments.text: Hi Kelly, I have been watch a fair few AI generated vids and tracks since discovering a few of yours a few weeks ago, and for me, you stand out amongst what is going become a crowded future creative space  for sure. I really enjoy the fact that you do not rely on cheap options such as exploiting the sexuality of the female form for example, as some others do. I find that each one of your creations have unique and semi realistic components in amongst the visual dreams you present. Somehow you get the right mix of realism and fantasy for me which I find makes watching each new creation quite compelling.  I don't know much about the global creative world, yet wouldn't be surprised if you aren't  inspiring designers of clothing, footwear and dance choreography at a minimum.   I started off watching your clips to inspire me to start painting again, and feel that that is now not far away.  Thanks, Blair
